text:
sara: Following up from the postmortem — consolidated action list for the KV-memory/OOM chain. Immediate mitigations, medium-term experiments, ops guardrails. Ack or reassign by EOD. 48h rapid loop, meet after with results.

mike: ack. I'll run lightweight heap-sampling and export. Plan: 15m probes every 4h, cap CPU. Artifacts to telemetry bucket.

mike: sampler cron:
```
0 */4 * * * /usr/local/bin/heap-sampler --scope=kv --dur=900 --limit-cpu=5% --out=s3://redwood-telemetry/heap-samples/2960123456/
```
Note: probe adds ~4% CPU on p3-small, will coordinate with infra.

anisha: I'll own medium-term experiments: slab tuning + eviction matrix + micro-GC prototype. Test plan: repro workload (tokenizer-heavy), slab_target=[0.5,0.6,0.7], eviction_policy=[lru,hybrid,hot-reserve-off]. Measure slab_frag_ratio, avg_rss, p99-latency. Will post gists + results.

ben: infra will mirror staging with matching residency & hotpath. ETA 2.5h. Canary will use 10% traffic slice, 20m watch window.

elaine: follow-up doc and daily digest template incoming. Digest fields: run_id, top_alloc_sites, live_rss, slab_frag_ratio, repro_steps, PRs, owner, status. Draft: https://drive.redwood/docs/kv-memory-followup (draft).

mike: first sample uploaded -> s3://redwood-telemetry/heap-samples/2960123456/run-001.json
snippet:
```
run_id: 001
node: staging-12
peak_rss: 8.1G
kv_residency: 82
top_sites: cache_manager.cc:412, tokenizer.cc:911
hotpath: parse->tokenize->kv_lookup
```

anisha: initial flag matrix:
- --slab-target=0.6
- --evict-hysteresis-ms=150
- --compact-threshold=0.25
Running pairwise A/B for 3 cycles, will report deltas.

sara: blockers: 1) deterministic repros (dev owners paste steps) 2) budget for extra staging nodes 3) safe rollback plan for canary.

dev-team / jules: repro steps pasted:
- call /v1/stream with payload X
- send 8 concurrent requests with large context
- observe rising RSS after ~6m

ben: PR #478 pushed with canary config + softlimit. softlimit excerpt:
```
softlimit_rss: 9G
kv_softlimit_pct: 80
oom_guard_delay_ms: 300
```
Canary scheduled 2026-05-10T09:30Z. Auto-rollback on >3% error-rate or >6% RSS delta.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary scheduled for staging group at 2026-05-10T09:30:00Z. Auto-rollback enabled.

mike: sampler outputs are lightweight JSONs; use `jq .` to inspect. I'll add a parser to the ops-runbook and a CSV summary.

anisha: if slab tuning doesn't fix fragmentation, next step is allocator changes to release pinned pages sooner. Prototype ETA 5d; will need perf tests.

elaine: daily digest schedule: 08:00 UTC starting tomorrow. I'll include tl;dr, top regressions, action status table.

sara: owners & deadlines (48h rapid loop unless reassigned):
- heap-sampling cadence + parser: mike (start now)
- slab/eviction experiment suite + results: anisha (matrix + initial results in 72h)
- staging & canary infra: ben (provision + PR monitor)
- follow-up doc + daily digest: elaine (first digest 08:00 UTC)
- repro steps collection: feature owners (post here)

sara: added recurring "OOM watch" slot on calendar (daily 08:15 UTC) for the next week to triage incoming samples quickly.

mike: posting run-002 shortly and adding summary CSV to S3 path. If I'm out, ping @nina who can run sampler.

nina: ack, can cover if needed.

sara: aim to convert effective mitigation into a platform-level guardrail (auto softlimits + alerting) after confirmation. :rocket:
